notes.title: v0.0.36
notes.content:
v0.0.36:
* sensitivity multiplier for those having trouble fine tuning the sensitivity of look
* fixes bug if quitting during pause menu

I also think I fixed the Steamdeck/Linux bug (a case-sensitive naming mishap) so it should work on Linux or Steamdeck now.
